documentation.description:
Supervisor restart policy (roadmap 16): what pcs_supervisor does when
the partition's process dies (exits unsuccessfully). R_None = launch,
never restart (default). R_on_Down = restart, at most restart_Max
times in any restart_Within-second window; past the budget, apply
restart_Then (quarantine the one partition, or TERM the deployment).
